notes.title: Update 4th Feb
notes.content: If you exit to menu during battle "Continue Last Turn (Beta)" option let's you load battle from start of the turn you left it in. If you notice any differences between the state you left the battle and the state you loaded in let us know

notes.title: Update 1
notes.content:
Added
-Added button to escape battle, it starts special event for now with only 1 option, more options will come in future
-Added Cancel button to level up screen
-Added basic WSAD camera movement with keyboard in fight scenes, more keyboard controls to come
-added training ground first pass in town

Fixed
-Fixed Steal Fortitude trait not working on Wounded Beast modifier
-Fixed follow up event(wyld lust, caretaker event) being possible to show up on dead characters
-Fixed some traits/traumas descriptions
-Fixed Diseased trauma not working correctly
-Fixed Octophobia not working if 8 was in number that has more than one digit (18,28 etc)
-Fixed Maultigore Swallow Event description showing lethal version even if it didn't kill character in "Try to crawl out" failure
-Fixed Replay crashing if used after killing Maultigore from his swallow event 
-Fixed Replay crashing if used after last hunter died during in-fight event
-Fixed special character animation, that is shown if Maultigore is killed by his swallowing event
